results.title: Create an Auth Token
results.snippet:
# Create an Auth Token

```http
POST /v3/user/tokens

```

Creates and returns a new authentication token for the currently authenticated User. The `bearerToken` property is only provided once, in the response body, so be sure to save it on the client for use with API requests.

results.title: MCP vs API for AI agents
results.snippet: MCP gives AI applications a standard way to discover and call tools. An API defines how software accesses a service, and an MCP tool often calls that API underneath. For an agent builder, the practical choice is whether to wrap the API directly in application code or connect through an MCP server.
